main_text.p: BEllar. neg. l. 1. de Pontif. c.4 de Cleric. c.47. de Laic. c.17. quiē-admodum etiam affirmat Electionē Episcoporum jure divino ad solum Pontificem Romanum pertinere, de Cleric. c.8. Nos affirmamus, adeoq; è contrario hanc propositionem formamus: Vocatio pastorum pertinet ad potestatem Magistratus & formaliter & objectivè. Seu clarius loquendo: Non soli ministri & personæ Ecclesiastica, sed etiam Magistratus de jure divino potestatem habent vocandi pastores Ecclesiæ: insuper quoque Magistratus officium est curam habere, ut ab ipsis ministris in vocatione pastorum omnia recte fiant, & abusus impedire imperio & potestate suâ. Propositio igitur hæc est bimembris. Prius membrum est: Etiam ad Magistratum pertinere formaliter jus vocandi ministros: Hæc doctrina est totius Ecclesiæ Reformatæ, expressa etiam constitutionibus Ec-clesiasticis speciatim Synodi Dordra-cenæ art. 4. 5. quemadmodum etiam

page.notes: Running head partly obscured at "Episcop[?]". The drop-cap B is set with the italic "Ellar." and is joined to it. Line-end hyphens are printed and kept. The page has no catchword in the text block; "ex" sits at the bottom right, below the last line, and is given only as the catchword. Some italic words near "vocatione pastorum" are blurred and are transcribed as printed with the best reading available.
